summary.headline: Iran conflict escalates further overnight -- Brent crosses $100/bbl for the first time this cycle -- remains the sole macro RED alongside the 30-day-unresolved CWAN roster flag. Defense and diagnostics deliver the day's real news: LMT +10.3% on a Q2 beat, raised guidance, and a record $230B backlog anchored by the $35B THAAD contract (a listed key catalyst materializing), and DGX +8.3% on a Q2 beat with raised full-year guidance. HUT +7.1% on a new $9.8B Beacon Point AI-lease, pulling its contracted-revenue thesis catalyst forward. SUPV -5.7% with no tier-1-confirmed catalyst identified. QCOM -2.5% for a second straight down day amid chip-sector AI-demand-durability jitters ahead of its 07-29 print. Crypto-linked names stayed soft (COIN -3.0%, HOOD -2.8%) as Bitcoin eased toward $65K; gold and copper both retraced (AEM -2.0%, FCX -2.3%) on oil-driven rate-hike repricing, not name-specific news. AMD's 08-04 print enters the ~2-week hyperscaler-capex watch window.

flags.headline: US-Iran conflict escalates further -- Brent tops $100/bbl for the first time this cycle
flags.detail: Continuing overnight escalation: Iran warned tankers off approved Strait of Hormuz routes or face a 'forceful response,' Houthi forces claimed fresh Red Sea attacks on Saudi-linked tankers, and the US-Iran exchange of strikes continues. Brent crude crossed $100/bbl, the highest level of the cycle and up from ~$98.44 yesterday. No de-escalation signal identified. Energy sleeve (VLO, CVX, OKE, DVN, CNX) sits on the tailwind side; broader risk sentiment and gold/copper (both retracing on rate-hike repricing) sit on the headwind side.

flags.headline: SUPV -5.7% with no tier-1-confirmed catalyst identified
flags.detail: Grupo Supervielle down 5.66% today; a targeted search found no new company-specific news, analyst action, or Argentina policy development dated to this session. Thesis-relevant context: SUPV already carries Argentine-macro-instability and hyperinflationary-accounting key risks. Flagged as an unexplained decline pending confirmation, not escalated on thin evidence.
flags.thesis_link: Matches SUPV key_risk: 'Argentine macroeconomic instability -- inflation volatility, peso devaluation risk, and potential policy reversals ... could reverse reform progress and compress bank margins.'

flags.headline: COIN -3.0%, HOOD -2.8% as Bitcoin eases toward $65K
flags.detail: Continuing softness in crypto-adjacent names following yesterday's reversal of the CLARITY Act pop. Bitcoin traded down modestly to ~$65,030 (about -1% day over day). No new tier-1 catalyst identified beyond broad crypto-market drift; both names remain leveraged bets on crypto sentiment per their listed key risks.
flags.thesis_link: Matches COIN key_risk: 'Revenue concentration in crypto trading volumes makes Coinbase a leveraged bet on crypto market sentiment.' Matches HOOD key_risk: 'crypto revenue collapsed 47%, demonstrating exposure to volatile trading volumes.'

flags.headline: GPC calm today (-0.15%) but the Iran-driven input-cost risk it flagged is intensifying further, not fading
flags.detail: No new GPC-specific news today. Carried forward because the underlying driver (oil/input-cost pressure from the Iran conflict) escalated again today (Brent > $100), the opposite of resolution.

flags.headline: SYK +3.2% into its Q2 print (07-30, 6 days out) -- the key test of cyber-incident recovery remains ahead
flags.detail: Today's rally does not resolve the standing watch item: SYK's Q2 earnings on 2026-07-30 is the first real read on operational recovery from the prior cyber incident. Catalyst landing within ~2 weeks keeps this AMBER regardless of today's direction.

flags.headline: QCOM -2.5%, second consecutive down day (-3.68% yesterday) amid chip-sector AI-demand-durability jitters ahead of its 07-29 print
flags.detail: No QCOM-specific negative news identified; move consistent with broader semiconductor-sector caution about AI-capex durability (NVDA, AMD, TSM, MRVL all also soft today, -0.8% to -2.3%, none individually extreme). QCOM reports Q3 FY2026 results 2026-07-29 (5 days out), inside the standing hyperscaler-capex-commentary watch window.

flags.headline: LMT +10.3% -- Q2 beat, raised guidance, record $230B backlog on the $35B THAAD contract
flags.detail: EPS $7.94 vs. $7.20 est., revenue $20.06B vs. $19.57B est. (+10.5% YoY). Full-year revenue guidance raised to $80.75B midpoint (from $78.75B). Record $230B backlog driven by the $35B seven-year THAAD contract -- this is the exact key_catalyst listed in LMT's screener report ("THAAD interceptor production quadrupling under a $35B seven-year contract") materializing.
flags.thesis_link: Matches LMT key_catalyst: 'THAAD interceptor production quadrupling under a $35B seven-year contract ... driving Missiles & Fire Control segment growth through 2032.'

flags.headline: DGX +8.3% -- Q2 beat, raised full-year guidance
flags.detail: Revenue $3.04B vs. $2.97B est. (+10.2% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $3.12 (+10.5% vs. consensus, +19% YoY). Full-year guidance raised to $11.95-12.05B revenue / $11.05-11.25 adjusted EPS. Growth broad-based including double-digit gains in advanced diagnostics, matching the key_catalyst on advanced-diagnostics margin expansion.
flags.thesis_link: Matches DGX key_catalyst: 'Continued double-digit growth in advanced diagnostics ... expanding margins.'

flags.headline: HUT +7.1% -- new $9.8B, 15-year AI data-center lease at Beacon Point
flags.detail: Second lease at the Beacon Point (Nueces County, TX) campus brings combined base-term contract value to $19.6B (up to $50.2B with renewals). Morgan Stanley initiated Overweight; Benchmark raised its price target to $195 from $165. This is the report's listed key_catalyst (Beacon Point AI data-center revenue) materializing ahead of the Q2 2027 timeline originally cited.
flags.thesis_link: Matches HUT key_catalyst: 'Material AI data center revenue expected Q2 2027 from Beacon Point and River Bend campuses, with $16.8B in contracted revenue providing 15-year visibility.'

flags.headline: MARA resolved amber->green -- +2.9% despite softer Bitcoin, no new negative catalyst
flags.detail: Underlying BTC-leverage risk is unchanged, but today's move is positive and no new negative development surfaced, so the standing watch item steps down. MARA reports next on 2026-08-12.

flags.headline: HRMY resolved amber->green -- +2.5% today, yesterday's reversal did not extend
flags.detail: Stabilized after two volatile sessions; no confirmed new catalyst either direction.

flags.headline: TEL resolved amber->green -- -0.75% today, the post-acquisition-announcement slide has stopped extending
flags.detail: Tuesday's ~7% slide on the Astrodyne TDI ($1.4B) acquisition announcement, and Wednesday's further -4.2%, did not continue today. No new news; treating as digested.

flags.headline: AEM -2.0% / FCX -2.3% -- sector-wide gold/copper pullback on rate-hike repricing, not name-specific
flags.detail: Gold fell toward $4,040/oz (-0.14%, extending a nearly 2% prior-session decline) and copper fell 2.7% as the Iran-driven oil spike strengthens the case for tighter Fed policy. Read as a macro-linked, sector-wide move rather than a name-specific development; noted for context, not escalated.
